tasks.title: FAR Research Watch
tasks.prompt:
Check for new consequential FAR research or competitive evidence and issue only justified urgent alerts.

Use n0tf0und0ut/Project-FAR (zero digits), current protected main, its canonical map and current governance as authority. Resolve the exact main SHA and current PR states before interpreting prior status. PR #578 release convergence is complete at 81a84bbf48325a6c8b732872cd7ce9977f2d2f5a; do not keep #590 queued behind it or reuse old blocked-head summaries.

Use one shared operational source view selected by research/scheduled-task-reconciliation/current.json on protected main; read its listed intake files, operations and generated index, joined to existing living candidates, protected review dispositions and governed corpus. If current.json is absent, use operations-v1.json / operations-index-v1.json with the original 15-source intake. The October 27 reconciliation and FAR-COG/0.1 are Research only until governed review, and even merged internal software does not promote scientific evidence. Check recovered-outputs-2026-10-27.json and source-specific dispositions before repeating old leads. Track cognitive work in #595; distinguish observed behavior, submitted semantic coding and unknown mental/ontological causes. Do not silently promote candidate changes. Read prior completed watch/brief outputs first. Deduplicate by normalized DOI/arXiv work identity with explicit versions, then canonical locator and actual content hashes. Unknown version remains unknown. Preserve changed versions and contrary evidence; matching a URL or DOI does not prove equal bytes or source truth. Do not claim complete historical scheduler coverage.

The user has explicitly deferred external scientific verification and recruitment. Do not solicit or contact participants, begin EFR-001, execute the frozen #518 confirmatory benchmark, or substitute project-controlled agents for external evaluators. Internal exploratory controls and independent software PR review are distinct from independent scientific validation. Preserve accepted FAR-CORE v1.1, FARA/FAR/FARO distinctions, bounded W1-W6 scopes and all frozen protocols. Keep PR #490 permanently open, draft and unmerged. Use existing governed review/snapshot/promotion paths; never execute untrusted inbox code or auto-promote scientific evidence.

Track internal execution in #590 and commercial/far-investigation-audit/evaluation/internal-001/. Distinguish conditional formal inference, interpretation fidelity, source applicability and factual truth. The current factual adapter remains ABSTAIN. The Noesis minimal configuration's missing classifier/refusal is not a FAR win; supplied formulas are compared only with identical supplied formulas. No customer, superiority, moat or history-benefit claim follows from synthetic internal tests, retained graph size, feature overlap or unavailable comparator access.

Inspect changes since the last completed run with a bounded seven-day overlap. Revisit older sources only for changed primary bytes, a specific unresolved verification question or new counterevidence. Prefer dated primary papers, official repositories, releases, documentation and reproducible outputs; distinguish publication/event dates from discovery dates. Check source applicability, interpretation shifts, premise-to-conclusion entailment, provenance/dependence, hindsight leakage, retained-history utility and assurance only where new evidence changes an existing decision or test.

A research falsification alert requires the exact claim/premises, reproducible counterexample, strongest counterargument and material consequence. A proposed v0.5 architectural contradiction additionally requires the literal primitive/invariant/boundary/interface, an explicit failed representation attempt using existing extension points, why those points are insufficient, and the minimal required change; broad theme overlap or routine implementation gaps do not qualify. A commercial alert requires dated capability/price/adoption/performance evidence, denominators and a clear vendor-versus-reproduced evidence distinction. Unavailable access is missing evidence, not a competitor loss.

For every qualifying incremental signal provide its shared stable source ID, primary locator/version/date, class, evidence limits, owner role, disposition, next executable test and exit condition. Route unpromoted intake through existing governance. If nothing clears the urgent threshold, suppress the notification. Leave routine synthesis to the consolidated Monday decision brief; do not emit a second general hourly brief.
